name: Omarchy Cleaner
author: momoledev
description: Reclaim disk space and memory, and check that your work is backed up: caches, package cache, logs, crash dumps, trash, leftover config backups, large files, RAM per app, plus a Checkup of projects, config backup and system health. Bar widget + scriptable CLI.

barWidget.description: Shows reclaimable disk space and opens the cleaner panel

schema.label: Show reclaimable size next to the icon
Background scan interval in hours (0 = off)
